textContent:
The scene is set. A reveals his identity to B after he has hijacked or helped the bad guys to hijack the college. The first run is about to end. The real boss of the organisation is taking his iconic entry within a few seconds. The build up is already set to place and B reveals his actual intention and tries to show A that he never knows the actual picture and always jumps to one conclusion, that he never learns from this only mistake:

B: You are smart, you tries to know all of it that the world has to offer but this backs your ego because of which you jump on to a single conclusion and takes your actions being adment to everything and everyone. This is how you have always been and I wanted to make you aware of that, open new possibilities for you. You must learn to get over your self centered shit of a brain to think with other's perspective. I knew you could write the best story but I only wanted to help you so I was after the idea in your brain that you have set for the ending, the way out for your character and achieve a true free will! and give it a direction maybe. But you are so full of yourself! I know what possible ending you could think of and I know that you believe the same for yourself as well. So don't try to hide it because I know exactly where you went and why you did what you did! But I am so obliged to say this in front of your face that YOU ARE WRONG! YOU ARE FUCKING WRONG! and now the things will go out of your hands again as they always do! As they went in ........ [about to mention the Childhood story of two brothers by destiny if not blood] 

THE SCENE cuts abruptly and the action sequence of the real BOSS cuts in and everything actually starts to go wrong in front of his eyes.
